descriptions.idol-tiki-bar: Chinese-Asian menu at a tiki bar: Hong Kong-style crispy wontons, pork bao, shoyu, miso and tonkotsu ramen, kung pao chicken, tom yum, fried noodles and rice; the bar specializes in tiki cocktails.
descriptions.x-wangs-kitchen: Chinese restaurant with a large menu of soups, noodles and dumplings; hot pot is a separate specialty. Popular dishes also include fried noodles, rice and sweet-and-sour chicken.
descriptions.kazi-vazi: Georgian khinkali bar: Megrelian khachapuri, khinkali with meat or cheese and herbs, beet and spinach pkhali, satsebeli and tsakhton sauces.
descriptions.meze-by-elliniko: Greek food designed for sharing: zucchini croquettes with tzatziki, kebab, orzo with shrimp and squid, grilled octopus, Greek salads and slow-cooked beef.
descriptions.pane-e-vino-west-65: Italian and Mediterranean food in West 65: homemade gnocchi with gorgonzola and tortellini with smoked ricotta, pasta, sea bass, tuna steak and octopus in a corn crust.
descriptions.marukoshi: Japanese home-style cooking beyond sushi: miso soup, donburi, ramen and udon with homemade noodles, gyoza, Japanese curry, okonomiyaki, yakitori, tempura and matcha desserts.
descriptions.sushi-wok: Asian-Japanese menu: rolls and nigiri, baked rolls, udon wok dishes, ramen, miso soup, tom yum, hot dishes and sushi burgers.
descriptions.sushi-tempo: Sushi and Japanese-Asian hot menu: rolls, nigiri and gunkan, gyoza, miso soup and tom yum, seafood wok, rice, bowls and edamame.
descriptions.sushi-tempo-vozdovac: Voždovac branch with the same Sushi Tempo menu: rolls, nigiri and gunkan, gyoza, miso soup and tom yum, seafood wok, rice, bowls and edamame.
descriptions.sushi-xo: Sushi chain with three Belgrade locations: signature and classic rolls, Philadelphia, tempura and baked rolls, maki, nigiri, gunkan, onigiri and soups.
descriptions.sushiboks-ada: Sushi bar in Ada Mall: rolls with salmon, tuna, shrimp and cream cheese, Philadelphia rolls, tobiko and masago, spicy and baked options.
descriptions.true-ramen: Ramen bar on Brankova: shoyu, miso, shio, tantan and kimchi ramen, chashu ramen, karaage, shrimp gyoza, edamame and beef tataki.
descriptions.burrito-madre-terazije: Mexican fast-casual: burritos and tacos with achiote chicken, barbacoa or carnitas, quesadillas, nachos, guacamole, salsas and churros.
descriptions.mala-moskva: Russian cuisine with a meat focus: chicken shawarma, chicken and pork shashlik, beef Stroganoff, borscht, okroshka and solyanka; drinks include mors and medovukha.
descriptions.ruske-palacinke-zemun: Russian-recipe crêpe shop on Masarikov trg: sweet crêpes with condensed milk, tvorog, jam and caramel, plus savory versions with ham and cheese or vegetable fillings.
descriptions.samovarrs-bw: Home-style Russian food on Karađorđeva: borscht with Borodinsky bread, okroshka, pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, crêpes, chicken cutlets and medovik.
descriptions.stroganov-family: Home-style Russian food and prepared dishes: borscht and okroshka, pork-and-beef pelmeni, homemade cutlets with buckwheat, crêpes, syrniki, medovik and Napoleon cake.
descriptions.ura-russian-dumplings: Russian food by Russian cooks: pelmeni with pork and beef, chicken, turkey and other fillings, vareniki with potatoes, tvorog or berries; fried versions, draniki and kvass are also available.
descriptions.thai-zone-vracar: Family Thai restaurant founded in 2017. Chef La-iad Nikolić prepares pad thai, khao pad, tom yum and tom kha, yum woon sen, spring rolls, wok noodles and Thai curries; the restaurant follows traditional Thai recipes.
descriptions.stories-georgian: Georgian cuisine at Piarona de Mondezira 28: khinkali with meat, cheese or mushrooms, Adjarian khachapuri, ojakhuri, satsivi, adjika and tkemali.
descriptions.cevabdzinica-savcic: Sarajevo-style ćevapi restaurant founded in 2013: ćevapi made to a Sarajevo recipe with 70% beef and 30% veal, pljeskavica, veal sudžukica and kajmak.
descriptions.curry-souls-centar: Sri Lankan street food: kottu roti, chicken and tuna curries, roti, dal and pol sambol. The Belgrade flagship opened in summer 2023; the founders are Clement Senaratne and Kai Bordel.
descriptions.kod-vijetnamca: Vietnamese food: phở bò and other rice-noodle soups, fresh and fried spring rolls, rice and noodle dishes; the menu explicitly presents the food as authentic Vietnamese cuisine.
descriptions.aigo-mashisoyo: Korean food: bibimbap, japchae, tteokbokki, gimbap, jeon, dosirak and jjigae; bulgogi, dak-galbi and gochujang-based dishes are also available.
descriptions.byblos-vracar: Lebanese food: hummus, falafel, tabbouleh and other mezze, shish taouk, manakish and Lebanese pastries. Byblos says it brought Lebanese cuisine to Belgrade more than two decades ago.
descriptions.maikhana-indian: Indian cuisine: samosas with chutney, butter chicken, aloo paratha, dal makhani, chicken or vegetable biryani with basmati rice, matar paneer and lamb curry; vegan dishes are available.
descriptions.milagro-zemun: Spanish-Mediterranean restaurant and tapas bar: jamón ibérico, Manchego cheese, padrón peppers, croquettes, paella Valenciana, black paella and seafood paella; crema catalana for dessert.
descriptions.puter-bistro: French bistro with a Balkan accent. Chef Vladimir Popović builds the menu around French technique: Parisian gnocchi, Dauphiné ravioli, duck, rabbit, fish and crème brûlée.
descriptions.pastel-de-nata-novi-beograd: Portuguese-Brazilian café: pastel de nata, brigadeiro, quindim, passion-fruit mousse, coxinha and empada. The project has two active Belgrade locations; this one is in Blok A at Uroša Martinovića 6.
descriptions.r-tiam-uyghur: Xinjiang Uyghur cuisine: lagman, lamb plov, steamed manti, lamb skewers, fried Xinjiang noodles and dapanji (新疆大盘鸡), spicy Xinjiang-style chicken.
descriptions.georgian-supra: Georgian cuisine: khinkali, Adjarian, Imeretian and Megrelian khachapuri, lobiani, shkmeruli, gebzhalia, pkhali and pelamushi; Georgian wines are available.
descriptions.turkuaz-restaurant: Turkish food: lahmacun, menemen, mezze and hummus, İskender kebab, beyti, bulgur and other kebabs; baklava for dessert. The restaurant at Dositejeva 1a states that its menu is fully halal.
descriptions.jan-restaurant: Armenian food: shashlik and grilled meat, lula kebab, pork ribs, chicken and shawarma.
descriptions.king-tut: Egyptian food: koshari, hawawshi, ta'ameya, mahshi, kofta, ful and om ali dessert.
descriptions.ikea-swedish-bistro: IKEA Swedish restaurant and bistro: meatballs, plant balls, Swedish pastries and cinnamon buns; the bistro also serves hot dogs and ice cream.
descriptions.hard-rock-belgrade: American food: Legendary Burger, BBQ ribs, wings, sandwiches, steaks and brownies.
descriptions.kfc-delta-city: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.
descriptions.kfc-ada-drive-thru: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.
descriptions.kfc-studentski-trg: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.

descriptions.kfc-ava-shopping-park: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.

descriptions.biryani-central: Indian food: chicken biryani, butter chicken, chicken curry, dal tadka, palak paneer, kheer and mango lassi.
descriptions.indian-punjabi-cuisine: Punjabi food: samosa and pakora, chicken tikka, tandoori chicken, curries, palak paneer, naan and chicken biryani.
descriptions.tao-thai: Thai food: pad thai, massaman curry, pad kra pao, pad see ew, tom-yum fried rice and dishes with coconut milk.
descriptions.tuk-tuk-thai: Thai food: satay, red and massaman curries, Thai noodles and rice, spring rolls and mango sticky rice.
descriptions.anadolija-turkish: Turkish and Anatolian food: menemen, shakshuka, haydari, pide, lahmacun, manti, saç tava and tandır kebab.
descriptions.kultura-turkish: Turkish food: menemen, shakshuka, haydari, ezme, pide, lahmacun, Turkish köfte and baklava.
descriptions.osteria-mozzarella: Regional Italian cuisine: pasta, risotto, pizza, meat and fish dishes, seafood, cheeses and desserts.
descriptions.trattoria-campania: Cuisine of Campania: wood-fired Neapolitan pizza, burrata, pasta, Neapolitan ragù, polpette and torta caprese.
descriptions.luigi-pizzeria: Italian street food: Neapolitan pizza, panuozzo, pizza a portafoglio, pasta, lasagna and arancini.
descriptions.moon-sushi-nbg: Japanese and Asian food: sushi and rolls, salmon tartare, edamame, gyoza, donburi and hot dishes.
descriptions.ebisu-square-nine: Japanese cuisine: teppanyaki, ramen, soft-shell crab, aburi sushi, sashimi and sake.
descriptions.hanan: Lebanese food: falafel, hummus, tabbouleh, shawarma, shish taouk, kibbeh, mezze and baba ghanoush.
descriptions.yalla-yalla: Lebanese street food: falafel, chicken shawarma, hummus, lentil soup and tahini-based dishes.
descriptions.zapata-pozo: Mexican food: chimichanga, guacamole, enchilada, burrito, quesadilla, tacos and pico de gallo.
descriptions.tortilla-casa-centar: Mexican fast-casual: burritos, quesadillas, soft and crunchy tacos, taquitos, Crunchwrap and churros.
descriptions.golden-wok: Chinese food: crispy chicken, meat with peanuts and cashews, sweet-and-sour dishes, udon, spring rolls and mapo tofu.
descriptions.yxlanzh: Northwestern Chinese cuisine: hand-pulled noodles and soups, dumplings, fried rice, cumin beef, tofu and wood-ear mushroom dishes.
descriptions.mo-sarpi-beograd: Chinese street food: roujiamo, a crisp flatbread filled with slow-cooked meat, cold liangpi noodles and baozi; located at Makedonska 5 near Trg Republike.
descriptions.da-noodles: Chinese noodle shop: homemade noodles in broth or dry, Hong Kong-style chow mein and chow fun, dumplings with beef, pork or chicken; located at Makedonska 5.
descriptions.k-kitchen: Korean and East Asian menu centered on bibimbap: beef, chicken, pork, shrimp and vegetable versions, spicy chicken with Korean gochujang paste; fried udon and tempura are also served.
descriptions.xalo-ocakbasi: Turkish ocakbaşı: Adana and Urfa kebab, tavuk şiş, dürüm, lahmacun, Turkish köfte, çoban salad and ayran; located at Makedonska 5, unit 33.
descriptions.intergalactic-diner-centar: American diner: classic, smash and UFO burgers, pork ribs, fries and onion rings, American pancakes with maple syrup and milkshakes.
descriptions.intergalactic-diner-novi-beograd: American diner: classic, smash and UFO burgers, pork ribs, fries and onion rings, American pancakes with maple syrup and milkshakes.
descriptions.asia-food-delta-city: Chinese food: hot-and-sour soup, fried rice and noodles, Sichuan chicken and beef, sweet-and-sour chicken, peanut chicken, mapo tofu and spring rolls.
descriptions.dva-stapica-nbg: Chinese food: hot-and-sour soup, spring rolls, chicken with peanuts in a spicy Sichuan sauce, sweet-and-sour chicken balls, wheat noodles and fried rice.
descriptions.good-dumplings-brankov: Chinese dumpling shop: hot-and-sour soup, pickled cabbage, boiled and fried dumplings with pork, chicken or beef, rice and noodles.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-dorcol: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-sarajevska: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-vracar: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: Siberian pelmeni, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-novi-beograd: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.big-daddy-smash-burgers: American street food focused on smash burgers: Classic, Big Daddy, OG and Jalapeño Smash burgers, French fries and onion rings.
descriptions.nanjing-xiaolongbao: Chinese snack restaurant on Kneza Mihaila: xiaolongbao with pork, beef or potato, boiled and fried dumplings, fried noodles and rice, Beijing-style zhajiang noodles and grilled skewers.
descriptions.panda-wok-balkanska: Chinese restaurant Panda Wok at Balkanska 23; confirmed by an on-site photo supplied on 5 October 2026 showing the 中餐馆 / Chinese Restaurant signage and 11:00–22:00 opening hours.
